text: Personal Details, Location, and Work Authorization: My name is Mujeeb Abdul Khawaja. I currently reside in Peshawar, Pakistan. My nationality is Afghan. I am available for remote work globally, but I do not hold US Citizenship, EU Citizenship, or security clearances. Languages spoken: Persian (Native), English (C1 - Fluent/Professional), Urdu (C2 - Bilingual), Pashto (B2).

I have approximately 1 to 2 years of professional, concurrent industry experience working as an Associate Software Engineer at DevBlock Studios and a Part-Time Full Stack Developer at Shahid Ahmad & Co. I excel in roles requiring modern AI stacks, RAG, and full-stack development, but I am not a Senior Engineer with 5+ or 10+ years of legacy experience.

These include the Microsoft Advanced AI and Machine Learning Techniques Capstone (2026), IBM Artificial Intelligence Fundamentals (2025), Cisco CyberOps Associate (2024), Cisco IT Essentials (2023), PMI Practical Application of Gen AI for Project Managers (2025), and DataCamp GitHub Foundations.

Profile Summary: Mujeeb Abdul Khawaja is an Associate Software Engineer based in Peshawar, Pakistan. He specializes in Full-Stack development and Machine Learning Engineering. He contributes to the design, development, and deployment of production-grade web applications and AI-powered platforms. He collaborates with cross-functional teams to build scalable backend services, responsive user interfaces, and LLM-driven retrieval and automation pipelines, focusing on performance optimization, cost efficiency, and real-world usability.

Role: ML Engineer at DevBlock Studios (Nov 2024 - Current). Built and optimized an intelligent RAG pipeline using vector databases to process large-scale document corpora, enabling semantic search with ~2.3s average response time. Designed and deployed an LLM query routing system using a fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B, achieving 92% routing accuracy and reducing unnecessary vector searches, saving ~40% on API costs. Contributed to architecting a bilingual AI platform handling 400k+ records. Built a multi-tenant financial document intelligence system integrating AWS S3 streaming.

Role: Full-Stack Developer at DevBlock Studios (Nov 2024 - Current). Built pixel-perfect Figma-to-Code interfaces using React and Tailwind CSS, delivering 300+ responsive screens. Implemented backend services using Node.js and Express.js following clean architecture. Designed REST APIs (CRUD, filtering, sorting, pagination). Diagnosed and resolved frontend and backend bottlenecks, improving page/API load performance by ~25%. Improved release reliability using Git workflows and CI/CD, reducing deployment failures by ~40%.

Role: Full Stack Developer (Part-Time) at Shahid Ahmad & Co. (Aug 2024 - Current). Engineered a production-ready POS & Digital Invoicing System deployed at major enterprise clients. Integrated the FBR PRAL Gateway API for real-time digital invoice validation and tax compliance. Built a secure financial engine using Node.js, Express.js, and SQLite3, utilizing Bcrypt for security and Puppeteer for automated, QR-coded PDF invoice generation.

Project: Afghan Civil Law Legal AI System. Built a RAG system over the Afghan Civil Code (9,000+ legal provisions) achieving 93% answer accuracy. Engineered a 3-stage retrieval pipeline: HyDE, Hybrid vector/BM25 search, and Neural cross-encoder re-ranking, reducing retrieval noise by ~40%. Designed context-aware chunking preserving Book/Chapter/Article hierarchy for precise source attribution. Deployed using a FastAPI backend and React frontend with persistent chat history and collapsible legal citations.

Project: VidEx - Final Year Project. Developed a cross-platform Flutter application that identifies movies from short clips by extracting and analyzing visual information from video frames. Designed a video-to-image processing pipeline using OpenCV to sample keyframes. Generated high-dimensional visual embeddings using the CLIP vision transformer and applied FAISS-based similarity search to match clips in visual feature space.

Project: Automated E-commerce Market Intelligence System (2024). Built an automated e-commerce price and availability monitoring system tracking competitive ownership signals across 1000+ SKUs. Developed a robust data acquisition pipeline in Python using Selenium and BeautifulSoup, ensuring 95%+ system uptime. Implemented event-driven alerting via SMTP and designed a data reporting layer using Pandas. Eliminated ~28 hours/week of manual monitoring.

Projects: E-commerce Product Scraper & Stock Report Automation. Developed automated systems to process stock/order data from CSV, Excel, and PDFs using Pandas and pdfplumber, reducing manual inventory control time from 4 hours to less than 5 minutes. Engineered a highly resilient web scraper using Python and Undetected ChromeDriver to extract high-value product data. Used Selenium and PyAutoGUI to automate uploading product details to an e-commerce admin panel.
